name: bedrock-agent-runtime
description: Contains APIs related to model invocation and querying of knowledge bases.

subcommands.name: create-invocation
subcommands.description: Creates a new invocation within a session.

subcommands.name: create-session
subcommands.description: Creates a session to temporarily store conversations for generative AI (GenAI) applications built with open-source frameworks such as LangGraph and LlamaIndex.

subcommands.name: delete-agent-memory
subcommands.description: Deletes memory from the specified memory identifier.

subcommands.name: delete-session
subcommands.description: Deletes a session that you ended.

subcommands.name: end-session
subcommands.description: Ends the session.

subcommands.name: generate-query
subcommands.description: Generates an SQL query from a natural language query.

subcommands.name: get-agent-memory
subcommands.description: Gets the sessions stored in the memory of the agent.

subcommands.name: get-document-content
subcommands.description: Retrieves the content of an ingested document from a knowledge base.

subcommands.name: get-execution-flow-snapshot
subcommands.description: Retrieves the flow definition snapshot used for a flow execution.

subcommands.name: get-flow-execution
subcommands.description: Retrieves details about a specific flow execution, including its status, start and end times, and any errors that occurred during execution.

subcommands.name: get-invocation-step
subcommands.description: Retrieves the details of a specific invocation step within an invocation in a session.

subcommands.name: get-session
subcommands.description: Retrieves details about a specific session.

subcommands.name: list-flow-execution-events
subcommands.description: Lists events that occurred during a flow execution.

subcommands.name: list-flow-executions
subcommands.description: Lists all executions of a flow.

subcommands.name: list-invocation-steps
subcommands.description: Lists all invocation steps associated with a session and optionally, an invocation within the session.

subcommands.name: list-invocations
subcommands.description: Lists all invocations associated with a specific session.

subcommands.name: list-sessions
subcommands.description: Lists all sessions in your Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: List all the tags for the resource you specify.

subcommands.name: put-invocation-step
subcommands.description: Add an invocation step to an invocation in a session.

subcommands.name: rerank
subcommands.description: Reranks the relevance of sources based on queries.

subcommands.name: retrieve
subcommands.description: Queries a knowledge base and retrieves information from it.

subcommands.name: retrieve-and-generate
subcommands.description: Queries a knowledge base and generates responses based on the retrieved results and using the specified foundation model or inference profile.

subcommands.name: start-flow-execution
subcommands.description: Starts an execution of an Amazon Bedrock flow.

subcommands.name: stop-flow-execution
subcommands.description: Stops an Amazon Bedrock flow's execution.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Associate tags with a resource.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Remove tags from a resource.

subcommands.name: update-session
subcommands.description: Updates the metadata or encryption settings of a session.
